goal: Investigate checkout error spike after production release

states.text: Release 2.4 deployed to production. Checkout errors rose from 0.2 percent to 18 percent within two minutes.
After rollback to release 2.3, checkout errors returned to 0.2 percent within three minutes.

goal: Check whether refreshing the content delivery cache resolves checkout failures

states.text: CDN cache refreshed while checkout errors remained at 18 percent; no reduction was observed after the refresh.

goal: Diagnose and repair settings save failures caused by a stale anti-forgery token

states.action: Submit the profile settings form with the existing token
states.text: The profile save request failed because the anti-forgery token was expired; the server returned an invalid CSRF token error.

states.action: Refresh the anti-forgery token before resubmitting the settings form
states.text: After refreshing the anti-forgery token, the profile save succeeded and the invalid-token error disappeared.

goal: Disable the new checkout experiment after a regression

states.text: With checkout-v2 enabled, the checkout error rate increased to 18 percent.
After checkout-v2 was disabled, the checkout error rate returned to 0.2 percent. The flag is currently disabled.
